metadata.name: solwin
metadata.description: SolWin: an on-chain slot that pays SOL or mints $SLW on every spin

instructions.name: accept_admin
docs: Step 2: the proposed key signs to become the admin, once the notice
period is over (so it's a key someone controls, not a typo). Nothing
else changes: pending withdrawals stay public and vetoable, and the
upgrade authority is separate.

accounts.name: new_admin
docs: Must be `revenue.proposed_admin`; checked in the handler.

instructions.name: accept_pauser
docs: Step 2: the proposed key signs to become the pauser, once the notice
period is over (so it's a key someone controls). Bumps the pauser epoch,
which voids any withdrawal requested under the old pauser.

accounts.name: new_pauser
docs: Must be `revenue.proposed_pauser`; checked in the handler.

instructions.name: buyback
docs: Sell $SLW back to the treasury at the floor price. Burns the tokens.
Stays open during self-exclusion so players can always cash out.

instructions.name: cancel_admin_change
docs: Only the pauser cancels a pending admin change. The admin can't: a thief
holding a copy of the admin key could otherwise cancel every legitimate
rotation forever. (The proposed admin can't either; the pauser already
covers a mistaken or hostile proposal, and fewer cancel paths is safer.)

accounts.name: signer
docs: The pauser only; checked in the handler.

instructions.name: cancel_pauser_change
docs: The current pauser or the admin cancels a pending pauser change.

accounts.name: signer
docs: The current pauser or the admin; checked in the handler.

instructions.name: cancel_spin
docs: Unsticks a spin that was never settled (the VRF callback never came).
Only the player can call it, and only `CANCEL_AFTER_SLOTS` after the
bet. The bet is forfeited: it stays in the treasuries, counts as a loss
for the player's limits, and mints nothing. A late callback for the
cancelled spin finds no spin account (or a newer spin with a different
seed) and fails.

accounts.name: player
docs: Only the player can forfeit their own spin; the rent goes back to them.

instructions.name: cancel_withdrawal
docs: The admin or the pauser can cancel a pending withdrawal (the pauser so a
separate hot key can veto a request made with a stolen admin key).

accounts.name: signer
docs: The admin or the pauser; checked in the handler.

instructions.name: deposit_bankroll
docs: Admin only. Adds creator bankroll to the vault. Unlike `fund`, this SOL
stays part of the creator's equity and can be withdrawn later.

instructions.name: execute_withdrawal
docs: Anyone, once the request has unlocked and before it lapses. Every rule
is checked again against current balances, pause and wind-down state.
The pauser that could veto the request must have held the role for the
whole notice period: execution fails if the pauser changed at any time
after the request, and while any pauser change is pending.

instructions.name: fund
docs: Anyone can add SOL to the vault, the buyback reserve or the jackpot pool.
It's a donation: SOL funded into the vault or reserve is counted so it
can never be withdrawn as creator equity or reserve surplus.

accounts.name: treasury
docs: Any of the three treasuries (the type check proves it is one of ours).

accounts.name: revenue
docs: Required, so a vault or reserve donation can't skip being counted.

instructions.name: init_revenue
docs: Admin only, once. Creates the revenue ledger. Everything already in the
vault and the reserve counts as donated, so none of it is claimable.
The pauser must be set and separate from the admin: the withdrawal veto
is worthless if one key holds both roles.

instructions.name: initialize
docs: One-time setup. Only the program's upgrade authority can call it, so
nobody can front-run the deploy and take the admin role.

instructions.name: migrate_randomness
docs: Admin only, one time: moves a config that still names a retired
Switchboard program to the MagicBlock VRF program. The target is fixed
in the code and MagicBlock isn't retired, so this can't be used again
or to point the game at any other randomness source.

instructions.name: pause
docs: Emergency stop for new bets. The pauser key (a hot key for fast
response) or the admin can pause; only the admin can unpause.
Settlement and buyback keep working so players are never locked out.

accounts.name: signer
docs: The pauser or the admin; checked in the handler.

instructions.name: place_bet
docs: Takes the bet and requests randomness from the VRF program, which calls
`settle_spin` back with it.

accounts.name: config
docs: Checked first, so a retired provider gives its own error before any
other account check (or the token account creation) runs.

accounts.name: slw_mint
docs: Created here because the callback has no payer: a loss mints into it.

accounts.name: oracle_queue
docs: program, which validates it.

instructions.name: propose_admin
docs: Admin only. Step 1 of an admin handover: public for ADMIN_CHANGE_DELAY,
during which only the pauser can cancel it. One at a time, so the clock
can't be reset to a shorter one. The pauser is the check on a stolen
admin key: it can always undo a handover to the thief, and the thief
can't undo the team's.
The program's own addresses can't be admin (nobody could ever sign), nor
can the current admin or pauser (one key never holds both roles).

instructions.name: propose_pauser
docs: Admin only. Step 1 of a pauser change: public for PAUSER_CHANGE_DELAY,
during which the current pauser (or the admin) can cancel it. One at a
time, so the clock can't be reset to a shorter one.

instructions.name: raise_vault_floor
docs: Admin only. The vault floor can only go up, and never above what the
vault holds now. Without that bound one call (say `u64::MAX`) would
freeze every live withdrawal until a wind-down; with it the worst case
is "no live withdrawals until the vault grows past the floor".

instructions.name: request_withdrawal
docs: Admin only. Announces a withdrawal; it can execute after WITHDRAW_DELAY.
The amount must be within the source's limit now and again at execution.

instructions.name: self_exclude
docs: Cool-off or self-exclusion. Can be extended but never shortened.
Pass `i64::MAX` for permanent.

instructions.name: set_limits
docs: Lowering a limit applies now. Raising or removing one is queued for 24 hours.

instructions.name: settle_spin
docs: VRF callback: only the VRF program can call it (it alone can sign as
the identity PDA it keeps for this program), and only with the
randomness requested for this spin (`request_seed` is echoed back).

accounts.name: vrf_program_identity
docs: The VRF program's identity PDA for this program; checked against
`vrf_callback_identity(config.randomness_program)` in the handler.

accounts.name: player
docs: tie every other account to it); receives winnings and the spin's rent.

instructions.name: start_wind_down
docs: Admin only, while paused. After WIND_DOWN_DELAY of continuous pause the
creator can withdraw all of their equity (floor and 10% cap lifted).
Unpausing cancels it.

instructions.name: update_config
docs: Admin only. The randomness program, floor price, bet split and paytable
can never be changed after initialize; only these bounded settings can.
Unpausing also cancels a wind-down. The pauser is not one of them: it
vetoes withdrawals, so it only changes through the time-locked
`propose_pauser` / `accept_pauser`.

accounts.name: revenue
docs: Unpausing clears a wind-down here.

fields.name: admin
docs: Changes bounded settings and roles. Should be a multisig (e.g. Squads).

fields.name: pending_admin
docs: Unused since admin handovers moved to `Revenue.proposed_admin`. Kept
(and never written) so the deployed `Config` layout doesn't change.

fields.name: pauser
docs: Can only pause new bets (a hot key for incident response).

fields.name: randomness_program
docs: VRF program that serves randomness (MagicBlock). Set at initialize;
`migrate_randomness` can change it once, away from retired Switchboard.

fields.name: floor_lamports_per_slw
docs: Buyback price in lamports per whole $SLW (200,000 = 0.0002 SOL).

fields.name: total_minted
docs: $SLW ever minted, in base units (burns don't free room under the cap).

types.name: Limits
docs: Player-set limits. 0 means no limit.

fields.name: pending_effective_at
docs: 0 = nothing pending.

types.name: Revenue
docs: Creator revenue ledger (seeds `["revenue"]`). See docs/creator-revenue-design.md.

fields.name: deposited
docs: Creator bankroll added with `deposit_bankroll`. Recoverable.

fields.name: donated
docs: SOL added to the vault with `fund`, plus the vault balance at `init_revenue`. Never recoverable.

fields.name: reserve_donated
docs: SOL added to the reserve with `fund`, plus the reserve balance at `init_revenue`. Never withdrawable.

fields.name: vault_withdrawn
docs: All SOL the creator has taken out of the vault.

fields.name: reserve_withdrawn
docs: All SOL the creator has taken out of the reserve.

fields.name: vault_floor
docs: While live, the vault never drops below this. Can only go up.

fields.name: wind_down_started_at
docs: 0, or when `start_wind_down` ran.

fields.name: pending_amount
docs: 0 = no request pending.

fields.name: pending_pauser_epoch
docs: `pauser_epoch` when the pending withdrawal was requested.

fields.name: proposed_pauser
docs: Pauser named by `propose_pauser`; default = no change pending.

fields.name: proposed_pauser_ready_at
docs: When the proposed pauser can accept.

fields.name: pauser_epoch
docs: Number of pauser changes since `init_revenue`.

fields.name: proposed_admin
docs: Admin named by `propose_admin`; default = no change pending. (Not
`Config.pending_admin`, which stays in the layout but is never written.)

fields.name: proposed_admin_ready_at
docs: When the proposed admin can accept.

types.name: SpinRequest
docs: One pending spin per player, created by place_bet and closed by settlement.

fields.name: request_seed
docs: Seed of this spin's VRF request; the callback must echo it back.
(Same 32 bytes as the old `randomness_account` field: layout unchanged.)

fields.name: commit_slot
docs: Slot the bet was placed in.

types.name: Treasury
docs: Program-owned SOL holder: the vault, the buyback reserve or the jackpot pool.
